prompt: People spend a lot of money on appearance because they want to look younger. why does this happen? Do you think this is a positive or negative development?
essay:
Many people argue that a large amount of money is spent on appearance so that people can look younger than their actual age. There are some reasons linked to this happening , and I believe this is increasingly a negative approach.

One of the major reasons why an excessive amount of money is spent on appearance is due to personal satisfaction. When people buy new clothes, jewellery, and other accessories, they are encouraged to feel motivated and happy. If individuals feel happy and positive about their appearance, improved performance can be achieved, which further enhances their confidence.

This approach can be considered negative , as financial difficulties could arise when a significant portion of people’s income is allocated to their appearance. It is widely accepted that a good personality is more important than physical appearance.However,  when people spend most of their income improving their appearance,  their financial resources can be wasted unnecessarily. Therefore, it would be appropriate for people to use sufficient funds for their appearance.

Another reason would be becoming materialistic. Individuals are often attracted by new advertisements and social media influencers, which create an unnecessary need to buy new clothes, shoes and other products. In order to experience temporary satisfaction, people purchase new products, making them more focused on material possessions and encouraging unnecessary spending.

In conclusion, a sense of happiness can be created among individuals when they spend money to enhance their appearance. However, it is highly important for people to manage their finances properly so that more money is not wasted on less-needed things.
